notes.title: Patch incoming !
notes.content:
A patch will be deployed tonight, to fix java's problem.
You have to install java 64bits (Last version, not necessarily Java 7.)

We are also working on the integration of multiplayer in the game directly.

Thanks for support :)

Stay tuned !

notes.title: How to play until next patch!
notes.content:
A patch will be updated 10/08/15.

Step 1: Uninstall Java 8 (If you are running Java 8)

Step 2: Install Java 7

Step 3: Go to your steam folder and run server.exe

Step 4: Run the game through steam!

*** If you want to play multiplayer, you must get there IP address and join there server. Characters are saved on your computer so you can use your single player character online.
